worldcombat.skill.foulplay.summary: A shadow arm reaches out along the aim and grows tick by tick: the first entity it touches is the one it twists back on. This move settles by the actual grabbed body's current Attack: the stronger the foe, the more force is borrowed; the user still joins through the shared damage formula's base coefficient, no longer as the main source.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.description.0: This blow deals about %1$s physical damage, driven mainly by the actual grabbed body's current Attack: the stronger the foe, the more force is borrowed; the user only joins through the damage formula's base coefficient.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.description.1: The shadow extends up to %1$s blocks, growing %2$s blocks per tick; the first entity it touches is grabbed. The grasp has a %3$s block radius; a wall stops it and reaching full range retracts it.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.use.2: Drag a strong foe into melee
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.preference.cl: On: on a hit, drag the target closer and leave it staggering (slowed), but this hit is ×0.88 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer. Off: the shadow only stabs upward, this hit is ×1.06.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in before reaching out. Higher reaches further targets first.
A target whose effective Attack reaches this value jumps ahead of other moves (one tier higher past it). Lower it to borrow strength from more targets.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.growth.0: From level %1$s: foul power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.growth.1: From level %1$s: foul power %2$s, shadow reach %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.cling.on: Cling: on a hit the shadow drags the target up to about %1$s blocks toward the user (stopped by obstacles) and leaves it staggering for about %2$s, moving 30%% slower; in exchange this hit is held back and the cooldown is longer.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.cling.off: Foul: the shadow twists and lets go on the spot, leaving no ongoing drag.
